model.name: Change Requests are first-class traceability children, individually approved (no bulk accept-all) — Tron ruling
model.description: Change Requests are FIRST-CLASS TRACEABILITY CHILDREN of the task, each INDIVIDUALLY approved — no bulk accept-all. Tron ruled (verbatim) our shipped CR model has TWO structural errors: (1) CRs sit in a SEPARATE 'Change Requests' list (renderChangeRequests reading model.changeRequests), NOT in the traceability chain — they must appear as CHILDREN exactly like Requirements do (his T40.1 screenshot: Traceability Chain / All Children with UseCase + Requirement; CRs belong THERE, same shape, same treatment); (2) the '✓ Resolve CRs' action (resolveCr, server.ts:1658) is a BULK ACCEPT-ALL (one processing-CR sub-step tick clears the band for all) — that must NOT exist. EACH CR is approved INDIVIDUALLY, AT the task, and the band derives from 'ANY CR not-yet-approved' so it clears ONLY when EVERY CR is individually approved. Per-CR approval is Tron's QA JUDGMENT and genuinely his (owner-gated, attributable — the R40.10 discipline, per CR). ★ This also RETIRES the bulk resolve mechanism (which is why it could not/should not be fired). REPLACE the mechanism, do not route around it.
model.tronQuote: CR requests must be listed in traceability the same way as requirements as children. There is no accept-all-CR — each CR must be approved AT each task.

discoverySource.verifiedBy: robbin-req measured the current wrong model: CRs render in a separate 'Change Requests' list (renderChangeRequests/model.changeRequests, server.ts:1428/1395), no per-CR approval field (CR 4babebb1), resolveCr (server.ts:1658) = bulk one-sub-step tick, band = R40.59 hasOpenCrSubstep single-substep

model.retires: resolveCr BULK action (server.ts:1658) / the single processing-CR-sub-step-tick band derivation (R40.59 hasOpenCrSubstep) / the separate 'Change Requests' list render (renderChangeRequests) — Tron: no accept-all-CR, CRs are traceability children.
model.answersBlocker: This is why the bulk CR-resolve could not/should not be fired (robbin-req was blocked; the bulk action SHOULD NOT EXIST per Tron). REPLACE the mechanism (per-CR approval), do not route around the block.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A CR renders as a CHILD in the task's Traceability Chain / All Children, the SAME shape + treatment as a Requirement (and UseCase) — NOT a separate 'Change Requests' list. The separate-list render (renderChangeRequests / model.changeRequests-as-a-sidebar) is retired; CRs join the traceability children.

gateRef.assertion: on the task surface, each CR appears in the Traceability Chain / All Children with the same shape as a Requirement child, not in a separate CR list

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a CR rendered only in a separate 'Change Requests' list (not as a traceability child) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each CR carries its OWN approval state (approvedBy + approvedAt PER CR), approved INDIVIDUALLY. No shared/bulk state. A CR is either individually-approved or not-yet-approved, tracked on the CR unit itself.

gateRef.assertion: every CR has its own approvedBy/approvedAt; there is no single shared 'all-CRs-resolved' flag

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a single shared resolve flag standing in for per-CR approval => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: NO bulk accept-all: the '✓ Resolve CRs' bulk action (resolveCr, server.ts:1658 — one processing-CR sub-step tick for the whole task) is RETIRED / MUST NOT exist. Approval is PER-CR only — the owner approves EACH CR individually AT the task. Tron: 'There is no accept-all-CR.'

gateRef.assertion: 0 bulk CR-resolve action (one action that approves/clears >1 CR at once); the per-CR approve is the only path

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a bulk resolve-all path (approves/clears all CRs in one action) => RED (this is the shipped resolveCr, to be removed)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The QA-Review-with-open-CR band derives from 'ANY CR NOT-YET-INDIVIDUALLY-APPROVED' — it clears ONLY when EVERY CR is individually approved, NEVER by one sub-step tick. Done is gated on ZERO unapproved CRs. Replaces the single-processing-CR-sub-step-tick derivation (R40.59 hasOpenCrSubstep).

gateRef.assertion: band present iff >=1 CR unapproved; clears iff ALL CRs individually approved; Done blocked while any CR unapproved

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: the band clearing on a single tick while a CR remains unapproved => RED; Done reachable with an unapproved CR => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each per-CR approve is OWNER-GATED and attributable to Tron (his profile-unit uuid, non-credential — the R40.10 discipline applied PER CR); it is genuinely HIS QA judgment at the task, never team-performed nor self-certified. (Contrast: closure MECHANICS the team may perform; a CR APPROVAL is his verdict.)

gateRef.assertion: a non-owner cannot approve a CR (403); an approved CR records the owner's identity attributably, per CR

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a non-owner approving a CR / a team-performed CR approval => RED
